trust_decision.summary: No trust decision as such: explodeHostedGitFragment runs two unanchored backtracking regexes (/(.*?)#.*/ and /.*:(.*)/) over an untrusted dependency or repository string, so a long input with no '#' or ':' costs quadratic time; the fix swaps them for split().

landing_point.why: The advisory names hosted-git-resolver.js explodeHostedGitFragment, and the two regex replaces are on lines 33-34.

fix_sites.entry_point: Resolving a dependency pattern with github:/gitlab:/bitbucket: or GitHub shorthand (yarn install/add) through the HostedGitResolver constructor at src/resolvers/exotics/hosted-git-resolver.js:56; also `yarn import` (src/cli/commands/import.js:56) and manifest normalisation of repository.url (src/util/normalize-manifest/fix.js:136 -> src/resolvers/index.js:59)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The fix is one shared helper. The manifest route (src/util/normalize-manifest/fix.js:136) and the import route (src/cli/commands/import.js:56) both call it, so the one-site fix covers them.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No route is left to dismiss. Every caller goes through the one fixed helper, and the only other routing into hosted resolvers (the git-resolver fork) is dead code behind `false &&` at src/resolvers/exotics/git-resolver.js:55.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Stripping a protocol prefix (github:, git@github.com:, https:) and keeping the #hash, a .git suffix and the user@host form (preParts handling) must still produce the same user/repo.

O6_input_shapes: fragment with several ':' (the last segment is kept, same as greedy .*:)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: explodeGistFragment could strip the gist:/hash with the same .replace(/(.*?)#.*/) idiom instead of split('#')
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is the sister parser for the same kind of exotic pattern and sits next to the vulnerable one; a maintainer copying the hosted-git idiom is plausible. WHERE-type only.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: explodeHashedUrl (used by git and tarball resolvers) could use a regex hash-strip in place of split('#')
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same job (split URL and hash) in another file and package area, reached by git URLs and lockfile entries (src/package-request.js:67).

O9_family: ReDoS / inefficient regular expression (quadratic backtracking on unanchored .* patterns)

O10_build.toolchain: Node.js + yarn/npm install, babel build, jest

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Replace the two regexes with split/indexOf in explodeHostedGitFragment, which is also the complete fix.

out_of_scope_notes: src/resolvers/exotics/registry-resolver.js:12 anchored /^(\S+):(@?.*?)(@(.*?)|)$/ on npm:/yarn: patterns may backtrack polynomially when the input contains a newline; different function and sink, not pursued.
unverified: repo_mb not measured (no shell size check done).
Whether the registry-resolver regex is actually super-linear was not confirmed by running it.
